title: Car Studio integration verified; licensed vehicle and device checks pending
summary: Viewer, translated learning controls, app navigation and independent local progress verified. Web/Android exports pass. No BMW geometry licensed or deployed; unrelated full-suite checks remain failing.

changes.detail: Corrected route typing and navigation lifecycle; remount restores latest progress. Studio progress now lives in a validated independent carStudio field in the existing AsyncStorage state, leaving course statistics untouched.

Exploded system offsets computed before transforms; viewer creation failures recover through Retry. Updated the More test harness to cover the studio route and its existing DeviceLabsSection dependency.
Repeatable multilingual runtime, synthetic GLB touch and app navigation/persistence tests; original synthetic geometry is test-only, never shown as a BMW.
Full bundled Three.js MIT license, source and asset contract, implementation inventory and documented test limitations. Prior history reports preserved; no deployment.

validation.name: TypeScript / focused ESLint / dependencies
validation.detail: tsc --noEmit and focused ESLint passed. npm ls confirms installed React 19.2.3, RN 0.86.3, WebView 13.16.1, Three 0.180.0 and types without peer conflicts.

validation.name: Focused automated tests
validation.detail: 13/13 tests passed: registry, translations, bridge, dedicated progress migration/validation, existing lesson progress, More navigation and append-only history.

validation.name: Browser runtime / synthetic GLB
validation.detail: Headless Edge: all 12 panels in English/French/Darija, levels, simulations, quiz/progress messages, written tour; 320px portrait, 844px landscape, 1440px desktop. Synthetic GLB loading/rendering, mesh selection, orbit/zoom, emulated two-finger pinch/pan, X-ray/highlight, isolation, paint, labels, explosion, disposal, 404 and retry passed.

validation.name: Actual app navigation and persistence
validation.detail: Local Expo export with disposable synthetic authentication: More to Studio, study save to AsyncStorage, reload restores study state, course completed array unchanged, Changes Made to visible history. No real credentials or backend calls.

validation.name: Expo exports
validation.detail: Local web and Android JavaScript exports passed. These are builds, not device installs or deployments.

validation.name: Full regression
validation.detail: Initial run 233/239 passed. More harness corrected and retested; offline adapter timeout passed on isolated rerun. Four unrelated checks remain failing: academy/source content drift, curriculum StudioVisual mock and wellness react-native mock. See artifacts/car-studio-regression.log and car-studio-unrelated-checks.log.

validation.name: Whole-app lint
validation.detail: 4 errors and 2 warnings in existing Home/PythonStudio/phone-relay code; focused changed-file lint clean. See artifacts/car-studio-lint.log. npm install also reported 29 app dependency audit findings, not remediated by broad upgrades.

validation.name: Real BMW model / physical devices
validation.detail: Required licensed F90 LCI GLB is absent. Real model proportions/internal geometry, full V8 simulation, native Android/iOS gestures, haptics, GPU/battery/FPS and persistent offline asset cache not validated. Tour is written and manually advanced; diagrams are simplified principles.
